map.name: Brackenford
map.trouble: Red Corwin's bandits hold the old watchtower on Crow Hill and rob the north road, so the north gate is shut.

bounty_offer.specifics: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays for the death of Greyjaw, the wolf taking his sheep.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Good day, stranger. I take it you've come about the reward?

I'll pay well for the pelt of Greyjaw, the big grey wolf. Since the thaw he and his hungry pack have been carrying off my sheep.

Mind yourself out in the Ashwood -- those brutes would eat you as soon as look at you.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Is Greyjaw dead yet? I've hardly any sheep left!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Well, well! The howling up in the woods went quiet, so I walked out to have a look.

You've done in that monster Greyjaw all on your own! Amazing! I take my hat off to you! That beast has been at my flock since spring! I'll skin him myself. My sheep can graze in peace now that the wicked brute is gone!

Now here's what I promised -- 100 in gold!

journal.text: Hunt down the wolf Greyjaw for Ulric.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants back her husband's enchanted gloves, taken from the mill by the Urchins of the old barrow.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
While I mind the mill by myself, there's another job I can't get to.

Those Urchins crept in at night and ran off with my husband's enchanted gloves. Their burrow is in the old barrow east of the ford.

Will you bring the gloves back to me, kind sir, and give those little pests a good fright?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Well! I'll just have to manage on my own, as always.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
The gloves! You got them back! Wonderful!

So the Urchins have a whole den down there? That's bad news for every house by the ford, but there's no time to fret over it. Halvard has been asking for you at the Moot Hall.

Here, take this for your trouble!

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: Thank you again! Those gloves stay locked up from now on.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's enchanted gloves from the Urchins in the barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Wenna's enchanted gloves from the Urchins in the barrow.

two_givers.specifics: Halvard wants back the tithe chest Red Corwin's bandits stole; Sly Wat, a turncoat of Corwin's in the Drowned Lantern, sells the key to the watchtower cellar.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
The whole town's talking about you, traveller! I could use a strong arm like yours. But first I need the tithe chest back -- Corwin's thieves carried it off.

Will you get it for me?

offer_b.speaker: Wat
offer_b.text:
Evenin', friend! Care to buy the key to Corwin's back door? It opens the cellar under the watchtower and it's a steal at 50 gold.

Well, do ya?

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text: The chest! Very good! The town armory can spare a longsword for you, and a mail shirt against the bandits' arrows.

outcome_b.speaker: Wat
outcome_b.text:
Pleasure doin' business. That key'll get you in, sure as anything.

Come find me if you want anything else of Corwin's.

journal_a.text: Return the tithe chest stolen by Corwin's bandits to Halvard.

journal_b.text: Buy the cellar key from Sly Wat in the Drowned Lantern.

rescue.specifics: Brother Anselm's novice Pip chased the Urchins into the old barrow and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Stranger! Please, you must help me! My novice Pip chased a gang of Urchins down into the old barrow east of the ford, and he never came out! The poor boy hasn't even got a stick to fight with!

Bring him home safe and the Chapel of the Ford will see you rewarded!

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Why are you still standing about? Pip could be hurt down there!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text:
Is somebody there? Oh, thank heavens! I came down after the Urchins and got lost in the dark!

Can you lead me back out? Brother Anselm will give you something nice, I'm sure, because he can't ring the chapel bell without me!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Go on, I'm right behind you! Get us out of this horrible hole!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text: Bless you, you've brought him back to us! Please accept these, with the Chapel's thanks!

journal.text: Find Pip in the Urchin barrow and lead him home to Anselm.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman points the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him after Red Corwin in the watchtower on Crow Hill and hands over the north gate key.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Find Halvard in the Moot Hall and send Corwin packing!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Sorry about the crowd, lad, but half the north road has fled in here since Red Corwin took the old watchtower. His bandits watch Crow Hill day and night and rob anyone on the road.

You must drive Corwin out of that tower, and he won't go quietly. It could come to blood. Here is the key to the north gate.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: Keep that key safe, the north gate is locked to everyone else. Corwin's men will see you coming up the hill, so stay off the road. Good luck to you.

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin from the watchtower on Crow Hill.
